text_blocks.snippet: Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) is an evidence-based psychotherapy that can be effective in treating depression. It helps individuals manage difficult thoughts and feelings by promoting acceptance, mindfulness, and commitment to actions aligned with their values. Instead of trying to eliminate negative emotions, ACT encourages individuals to acknowledge them and then take meaningful steps towards living a fulfilling life.
